finalText:
All tests pass now. The bug was in `src/services/pricing.js` line 22: it was subtracting the flat coupon (in USD) from the already-converted total, mixing currencies.

The fix applies the flat coupon before conversion. Since both the subtotal and coupon are in USD, subtracting $10 from $100 USD gives $90 USD, which then converts to 81 EUR (90 × 0.9). Before, it was converting first (100 × 0.9 = 90 EUR) then subtracting the $10 USD coupon, giving 80 EUR.

Percent coupons still apply after conversion since they're currency-agnostic. All 5 tests pass.
